summary: CHASE the tree-specific non-BI-covered nondeterminism (CASE-2-TREE-SPECIFIC): tree diverges at lcp=1 same-seed within-boot under full BI while native is 3/4-exact. Phase 1 CPU: classify every tree-path op for run-to-run determinism + add a flag-gated torch-deterministic warn-detector. Phase 2 GPU (serialized): B=1-vs-B=4 same-seed bisection + detector log. Phase 3: root-cause + flag-gated fix if clear. Phase 4: adversarial verify.

classify.findings:
CPU op-determinism audit of the FR13 tree-verify path (all paths absolute under /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel). Per-op classification:

(1) RNG MISUSE — CERTAIN, SAMPLES TOKEN 1 ITSELF. scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:3749-3750, inside `_lumo_tree_canonical_multidraft_sample` (the sampled tree committer): `seed = int(torch.randint(0, 2**31-1, (1,), device=output_token_ids.device).cpu().item()); rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)`. The seed is drawn from the GLOBAL torch CUDA RNG (no generator arg), once per rejection_sample call, then the numpy rng drives EVERY accept/reject draw, source choice, and residual resample (src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr10_tree_rejection_sampler.py:112-215), consumed sequentially across req_i in batch order. The campaign was temp 0.6 (FR13_METHOD_A_PARTIAL_BIND.md) so this path emitted the first generated token. vLLM's per-request generators (sampling_metadata.generators, what makes native 3/4-exact) are completely bypassed. Within one boot, run b starts with the global RNG state advanced by run a's draws -> different seed at the very first commit event -> lcp=1 on prompt0 WITHOUT any logits difference. Per-call seed + batch-order consumption = cross-request mixing; the number of committer calls before a given request's event depends on co-scheduling -> explains cross-boot lcp 17 too. accept/event unmoved (~2.0) is consistent: statistics unchanged, draws differ. The greedy committer (`_lumo_tree_path_lcp_max_greedy_sample`, :3423) is RNG-free; only the sampled path is affected.

(2) SLOT-KEYED PERSISTENT BUFFERS, STALE AT FIRST EVENT — CERTAIN STALENESS, EXECUTES BEFORE TOKEN 1, PRODUCES DIFFERENT LOGITS FOR IDENTICAL INPUT. `fr10_tree_accepted_paths`/`fr10_tree_accepted_lens` are device buffers allocated ONCE at metadata-builder init (patch :184-205), zero-init, exported as module globals (_LUMO_FA_ACCEPTED_TREE_{PATHS,LENS}_TENSOR), keyed by BATCH POSITION not request id. Written only by the committer each step for rows [0..num_reqs) (:3625-3638 greedy, :3947-3960 sampled); never reset per-request. Read at the START of the next tree-verify forward by (a) `launch_tree_state_linear_remap` (:759-767), (b) the tree-GDN kernel h0 column select `h0_column = max(lens[b]-1, 0)` (:2476-2480 -> kernel src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:259-267), (c) conv prior-window read col (:804-816). For the FIRST spec decode of any request on slot b, lens/path hold the PREVIOUS occupant's values (or warmup leftovers): the remap shuffles the fresh request's state bank columns by a stale path (can clobber the prefill state in column 0), and h0 is read from a stale column holding garbage -> wrong h0 -> different logits at token 1, history-dependent (differs run-to-run within boot; garbage-dependent cross-boot). Additionally vLLM's persistent-batch swap-removal reorders slots on completion -> row b transiently carries a DIFFERENT request's path = cross-request mixing.

(3) IN-PLACE OVERLAPPING-PERMUTATION RACE — RACE BY CONSTRUCTION, fires on every event with accepted_len>=2. `_linear_remap_rows_kernel` (src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:85-167, called via launch_tree_state_linear_remap for BOTH ssm_state and conv_state): grid (B, path_cols, row-blocks), all programs concurrent, no ordering. Program k loads bank row spec_state_indices[b, accepted_paths[b,k]] and stores bank row spec_state_indices[b, k]. Committer publishes GDN node ids = committer node + 1 (:3599-3602), so a spine accept of length L gives path=[1..L]: src columns 1..L overlap dst columns 0..L-1 -> program k-1 reads the exact bank row program k concurrently overwrites (a parallel in-place shift-left). Nondeterministic winner for every L>=2; with accept/event ~2.0 this fires constantly, corrupting ssm AND conv state -> different logits for identical input on subsequent events (explains lcp 11/11/57 and cross-boot 0/4). It is also a correctness bug (col k can get col k+2's state), independent of determinism.

(4) DUPLICATE-INDEX index_copy_ — EXONERATED BY CONSTRUCTION (pending in-container confirmation). The publish `ssm_state.index_copy_(0, spec_state_indices_tensor[fr10_b,:tree_n], ...)` (:2751-2755), `conv_state.index_copy_` (:1321-1327), and the FR12-oracle `tree_out/tree_state.index_copy_` (:2544-2555, env-gated) all index with spec_state_indices rows. Traced construction in vLLM source (/tmp/fr10_vllm_src/gdn_attn.py:255-279 + attn_utils.py:854-893): spec_state_indices_tensor = block_table_tensor[mask, :num_spec+1], where mamba_get_block_table_tensor ("align" mode) gathers num_spec+1 CONSECUTIVE block-table entries per request — distinct allocated KV blocks, so no duplicates within a row and rows are disjoint across requests; the per-b python loop serializes the copies. Deterministic given healthy block tables.

(5) Tree GDN scan kernel (`_tree_gdn_kernel`, fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:206-353) — deterministic by construction, as expected: tl.static_range sequential scan, each program owns disjoint (node, v-head, v-block) output/state slices, single fp32 path, the only atomic is the FR10_METRICS-gated invocation counter (relaxed, counter only).

(6) FA2 fork (scripts/fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py) — additive in-register `apply_tree_bias` after QK in all four forward loops (no new reductions/atomics/dropout); decode call passes num_splits = attn_metadata.max_num_splits (deterministic given batch shape; campaign asserted FR13_BI_TREE_ATTN=1). Run-to-run deterministic for fixed shapes; only batch-composition-sensitive via shape-dependent split heuristics. Low.

(7) Glue ops: torch.unique (:663, :1626, :1720), .nonzero (:6715), dict-keyed _FR10_COMMIT_HANDOFF_CURR_CONV_BY_B (:1311) — all diagnostics-env-gated (FR10_METRICS / FR12_* / handoff log envs), inert in the campaign. CPU-side committer python is deterministic given inputs.

EVIDENCE FIT: #1 alone explains the within-boot lcp=1 signature (token 1 is sampled by the committer with a history-dependent global-RNG seed — no logits change needed); #2 explains token-1 divergence WITH different logits (the literal KEY DEDUCTION); #3 explains the sustained per-event divergence and cross-boot non-exactness. Native is untouched by all three (stock rejection_sample + metadata num_accepted_tokens), matching 3/4-exact. Suggested fixes (not implemented, audit-only): use per-request generators from sampling_metadata in the committer; key/reset the accepted-path buffers per request (or take first-step lens from metadata.num_accepted_tokens); double-buffer or stage the remap (gather to scratch, then scatter).

classify.detector_hook: Implemented, committed fe1f669d on main, pushed. New `_patch_gpu_model_runner_fr13_det_warn()` in /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py (registered in main() patch_steps): appends a sentinel-guarded (`# FR13_TORCH_DET_WARN`) module-level installer to vLLM's gpu_model_runner.py, which imports in every worker process (= worker init). Default = no-op (verified: det mode stays False, zero side effects). With FR13_TORCH_DET_WARN=1: calls torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True), sets warnings.filterwarnings("always", message="(?i).*deterministic.*") so EVERY hit fires (not once-per-site), and wraps warnings.showwarning to log each nondeterministic-op warning plus the full Python call stack (traceback.format_stack, the warn fires host-side at op dispatch so the stack is the true caller; CUDA launch blocking stays OFF) to FR13_TORCH_DET_WARN_LOG (default /logs/fr13_torch_det_warn.log, StreamHandler fallback), then chains to the previous showwarning. py_compile clean on the patcher; injected block compiled standalone and exercised on CPU (active mode logged 2 entries with stacks).
classify.problems: 1) Detector blind spots — important for interpreting its log: torch's deterministic-alert machinery only sees ATen ops. It will NOT flag the three top-ranked carriers: the numpy RNG in the committer (pure python), the Triton remap-kernel race, and the stale-buffer wiring. A clean FR13_TORCH_DET_WARN log does NOT exonerate the tree path; the hook pinpoints torch-op offenders (index_put_/scatter_add/cumsum/etc.) only. The top-3 need targeted fixes/instrumentation. 2) While the flag is ON, warn_only mode also switches ops that DO have deterministic implementations onto them (slower; may alter CUDA-graph capture) — diagnostics only, never measure with it; this is documented in the injected comment. 3) Duplicates exoneration for index_copy_ was traced against /tmp/fr10_vllm_src + /tmp/vllm_pristine_019 copies of vLLM, not the live container (NO GPU constraint); re-confirm the live gdn_attn.py/attn_utils.py match at next boot. 4) Task statement said tree cross-boot 'same' but FR13_METHOD_A_PARTIAL_BIND.md records T1-vs-T2 = 0/4 exact (lcp 17/11/11/...); I treated the doc as authoritative — the global-RNG + race candidates are consistent with cross-boot NON-exactness. 5) No GPU validation performed (per task); the remap race and stale-buffer effects are established by construction/code-reading and should be confirmed with the planned B=1 same-seed bisection.

fix.root_cause: Three confirmed channels, all tree-path-only, per the audit + bisection and verified in source: (1) RNG — the sampled tree committer (`_lumo_tree_canonical_multidraft_sample`, scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py) seeded its numpy rejection rng from the GLOBAL torch CUDA RNG (`torch.randint` with no `generator=`), once per rejection_sample call, consumed sequentially across requests in batch order — same-seed reruns see a different global offset (every prior tree event advances it), producing the campaign's within-boot lcp=1 at temp 0.6 with no logits change; per-request generators (sampling_metadata.generators) were bypassed. (2) Slot-keyed persistent accepted-path/lens device buffers — allocated once at metadata-builder init, written by the committers keyed by BATCH POSITION, never reset per request: a slot's new occupant's first tree-verify forward consumed the previous occupant's path/lens (wrong state-bank remap + wrong h0 column → different logits for identical input), and persistent-batch swap-removal reorders handed rows across requests. (3) In-place overlapping-permutation race in `_linear_remap_rows_kernel` (src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py) — parallel path-column programs where spine paths overlap their destinations (src cols [1..L] → dst cols [0..L-1]), so the program writing column k races the program reading it as source, on both ssm and conv state, for every accepted_len ≥ 2 (race by construction; also a correctness bug).
fix.fix_applied: Commit cc008587 on main (pushed), 'FR13 chase: committer global-RNG + slot-keyed stale buffers + remap race fix (flag-gated)'; results bind doc da113115. Three flags, all default ON (each provably semantics-preserving for the deterministic case, each independently revertible): (a) FR13_TREE_PER_REQ_GEN=1 — committer rng seeded per request from sampling_metadata.generators[req_i] (the stock vLLM mechanism; distribution-preserving, only the stream source moves); =0 restores the legacy single global-seeded rng bit-for-bit. (b) FR13_TREE_REQKEY=1 — committers (greedy + sampled) publish accepted gdn paths/lens into a request-id-keyed dict on gdn_linear_attn; a new `_patch_gpu_model_runner_tree_reqkey()` injects a pre-forward rewrite in _prepare_inputs (after num_decode_draft_tokens.copy_to_gpu) that installs the CURRENT spec-row occupants' own values (zeros for a request's first spec step) into the persistent device buffers every step, exports the sampler-row→req-id map, and prunes finished requests; under stable occupancy beyond the first event the installed values equal what the buffers already held. (c) FR13_TREE_REMAP_SEQ=1 — new race-free `_linear_remap_rows_gather_kernel`: one program owns ALL path columns for a (batch, element-block) slice, every source row slice loaded into registers before any store (exact in-place overlapping permutation). Launcher scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh forwards all three. Validation: py_compile clean; 13 new CPU behavioral tests in tests/test_fr13_nondet_chase_fixes.py (RNG isolation from the global stream, flag-off legacy equivalence, req-keyed publish + fail-loud without row req-ids, first-event zeroing, zombie pruning, flag-off inertness, patch application + py_compile against the pristine vLLM 0.19 tree) plus 55 existing related tests all pass; in-container patcher applied cleanly on the live image (all patch steps True, FA2 fork sha 97fa2519 matches campaign).
